hero.aria: Introduction to the Pastek Art creative exercise generator
hero.lead: Pastek Art invites you to explore drawing, painting and collage as a gentle game — guided prompts, a creative mirror, nothing clinical. Your AI key stays with you (BYOK); your traces stay local.

benefits.aria: Benefits of a daily creative ritual
benefits.title: Why bring a creative ritual into your day?
benefits.intro: A creative exercise asks for no technical skill and no special talent. The point is not a polished artwork, but fully inhabiting the process. Practiced regularly, it grows curiosity, ease and everyday wellbeing:
benefits.item1Body: Attending to lines, shapes and colours helps settle the pace and come back to yourself.
benefits.item2Body: Simple, intuitive prompts make it easier to leave the fear of the empty page behind.
benefits.item3Body: Let the gesture lead the discovery — curiosity, play and materials before judgment.

how.title: How it works
how.p1: No complex kit required: a notebook, a pen, markers, pastels or a few scrap sheets are enough. Start the generator and let a clear prompt set you in motion.
how.p2: Each session offers a creative invitation matched to your impulse of the moment, then a kind mirror after you create — a creative coach, never a diagnosis. Bring your own AI key (BYOK) or use the free mode.

ctaBand.title: See a sample journey
ctaBand.body: Impulse, AI prompt, making, and creative mirror — see what a full ritual looks like before you begin.
